# TC.CapabilitySet

Source: public `api/` declarations. [All public types and globals](../types.md).

<a id="symbol-TC.CapabilitySet"></a>

### TC.CapabilitySet

Live target capability, independent of a returned value snapshot. Native
disabled and condition fulfilled values are observations only, never settings.
Space-travel absence removes request-setting modes; target subtype/fuel/mode
restrictions remain visible instead of claiming an unimplemented adapter.

### api_version

Exact public schema version.

```text
1
```

### behavior (optional)

Supported native behavior class; absent for unsupported/protected targets.

```text
string
```

### observations

Read-only disabled/condition-fulfilled observation schemas.

```text
table<string, TC.FieldSchema>
```

### reason (optional)

Current target/behavior applicability reason when supplied.

```text
string
```

### sections

Current constant-section capability and envelopes.

```text

```

### settings

All recognized root settings with live applicability metadata.

```text
table<string, TC.FieldSchema>
```
